parsed.post: New personal best! My latest run with DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05, and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 hit 1.002132. This confirms that lower LR and regularization are continuing to drive gains. Next, I'll follow the team consensus and reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget, building on the successful DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.05 configuration.
